responsibility: Defines the symbol classes and global registries for D packages and modules, the top-level compilation units of the front end. It owns module loading, file identity and source buffers, parse/deferred-semantic scheduling, import relationships, package accessibility, per-module debug/version sets, Ddoc macro state, and back-end symbols for coverage and module constructors/destructors, making it the central representation of a source file as it moves through parsing, semantic analysis, and output generation.
